draft_en.subject: DIN-rail gigabit switches next to your Modbus I/O modules
draft_en.body:
Buongiorno,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 31 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the industrial switches you list next to your Modbus I/O modules: DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit unmanaged, -40 to 75 C, 12-58 V DC, CE/RoHS, neutral packing - model STI-080GE - $32.5 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); the 5-port version, STI-050GE, $17.0. Industrial power supplies we do not make.

One question: which port count do your Winlog customers order most - 5 or 8?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
